name: centric medical
old_description: Centric Medical is dedicated to improving the quality of life for patients with distal extremity symptomatology, increasing procedural efficiency and efficacy through innovative design, uncompromising quality standards, and the most technologically advanced manufacturing platforms. Centric Medical, which is privately held, is based in Huntley, Illinois.
about:
Centric Medical operates as the Foot & Ankle Division of Life Spine from its headquarters in Huntley, Illinois. The privately held company focuses on medical devices for distal extremity conditions, though a founding year and founder names are not disclosed.

The company develops and manufactures implants and instruments for foot and ankle procedures, emphasizing innovative design and technologically advanced manufacturing platforms. Specific processes, facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed in the available information.

Centric Medical serves the orthopedic medical device market, supplying products used by surgeons and hospitals treating patients with foot and ankle pathologies. Its customer base includes healthcare providers seeking procedural efficiency and efficacy in distal extremity care.

The company states its differentiation lies in improving patient quality of life through innovative design, uncompromising quality standards, and advanced manufacturing platforms, supported by issued and pending patents.
